title: Absorb g copies of the heavy slice by the factor-2 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The `g` copies of the heavy slice fit the factor-2 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `2 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`, `g` copies of

```text
(p^{10})^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2)
```

are strictly below `2^{-C p}`. The gate forces `g < 2^L`, so the copies add one `L`. For `p ≥ 64`, `8 L ≤ p`, and `16 L` becomes `2 p`. Two times the eighths is then at most `82 p + 16 - 8 p^2`. The polynomial `8 p^2 - 82 p - 32` equals `27488` at `p = 64` and increases by `16 p - 74`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

At `p = 84` and `g = 6`, `2 g L = 84 ≤ 84` while `3 g L = 126 > 84`, and the copies exponent is `-6628`. This `2` multiplies `g L`. It is not a two-bit majorant of the ceiling `9` and not a two-power majorant of `C`. The coefficient-9 monomials in #4495 still use `16 g L ≤ p`, because `9 > 8`. At `p = 2` and `g = 1` the factor holds, `2 g L = 2 ≤ 2`, but `p < 64`. Since `e < 3`, that one copy is larger than `1`.

A factor smaller than `2` stays open. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`. This answers the open question of #4684. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_TWO_COPIES` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run
